description: This script generates an abseil.podspec file from Bazel build files, analyzing BUILD.bazel files to produce a CocoaPods specification for the Abseil C++ libraries.

classes.name: Rule
classes.description: Named tuple representing a Bazel build rule with fields for type, name, package, source files, headers, dependencies, visibility, and test-only flag.

methods.name: get_elem_value
methods.description: Retrieves the value of an XML element with a specified name.

methods.name: normalize_paths
methods.description: Converts Bazel XML paths to normalized relative paths.

methods.name: parse_rule
methods.description: Parses an XML element into a Rule object.

methods.name: read_build
methods.description: Runs Bazel query to retrieve all cc_ rules in a package and returns them as Rule objects.

methods.name: collect_rules
methods.description: Recursively collects all relevant rules from the root directory.

methods.name: relevant_rule
methods.description: Determines if a rule is relevant for generating the podspec (cc_library, non-empty, not test-only).

methods.name: get_spec_var
methods.description: Returns the variable name for a given depth in the podspec hierarchy.

methods.name: get_spec_name
methods.description: Converts a Bazel label to a podspec name, ensuring it starts with //abseil/.

methods.name: write_podspec
methods.description: Writes the complete podspec file based on rules and arguments.

methods.name: build_rule_directory
methods.description: Builds a nested dictionary representing the directory structure of rules.

methods.name: write_podspec_map
methods.description: Recursively writes the podspec subspecs from the rule map.

methods.name: write_podspec_rule
methods.description: Writes a podspec subspec for a single rule, including source files and dependencies.

methods.name: write_indented_list
methods.description: Outputs a list of values in an indented, formatted style.

methods.name: generate
methods.description: Main function to generate the podspec from all BUILD files under the 'absl' directory.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Entry point for the script, parses arguments and triggers generation.
